'use client' import { modelPalette } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/ai-usage' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, BlockStateRows, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { formatNumber, formatPercent } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' import { cn } from '@/lib/utils' interface ModelPerformance { /** Share of requests that errored, 0–1. */ errorRate: number label: string /** Output tokens per second while streaming. */ outputSpeed: number requests: number /** Time to first token, median, in ms. */ ttftP50: number /** Time to first token, 95th percentile, in ms. */ ttftP95: number } interface AiUsage3Props { /** Defaults to a sentence naming the busiest model and any over the error threshold. */ description?: string /** Error rate above which a model is flagged, 0–1. */ errorThreshold?: number /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ models?: ModelPerformance[] status?: BlockStatus title: string } const exampleProps: AiUsage3Props = { models: [ { errorRate: 0.004, label: 'Reasoning', outputSpeed: 58, requests: 41_200, ttftP50: 1_240, ttftP95: 3_880, }, { errorRate: 0.0012, label: 'Fast', outputSpeed: 164, requests: 318_000, ttftP50: 310, ttftP95: 790, }, { errorRate: 0.021, label: 'Vision', outputSpeed: 91, requests: 12_600, ttftP50: 880, ttftP95: 2_940, }, ], title: 'Model performance, last 24 hours', } const ms = (value: number) => value >= 1_000 ? `${formatNumber(value / 1_000, { maximumFractionDigits: 2, minimumFractionDigits: 2 })} s` : `${formatNumber(value, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} ms` const percent = (value: number, digits = 0) => formatPercent(value, { maximumFractionDigits: digits, minimumFractionDigits: digits }) const describe = (models: ModelPerformance[], errorThreshold: number) => { const requests = models.reduce((sum, model) => sum + model.requests, 0) const busiest = models.reduce( (top, model) => (top && top.requests >= model.requests ? top : model), undefined, ) if (!busiest || requests === 0) return 'No requests in this period.' const flagged = models.filter((model) => model.errorRate > errorThreshold) const errors = flagged.length === 0 ? `Every model is under the ${percent(errorThreshold)} error threshold.` : flagged.length === 1 ? `${flagged[0].label} errors on ${percent(flagged[0].errorRate, 1)} of requests, over the ${percent(errorThreshold)} threshold.` : `${flagged.length} models are over the ${percent(errorThreshold)} error threshold.` return `${busiest.label} served ${percent(busiest.requests / requests)} of ${formatNumber(requests)} requests. ${errors}` } function LatencyRange({ max, p50, p95 }: { max: number; p50: number; p95: number }) { const at = (value: number) => `${(Math.min(value, max) / (max || 1)) * 100}%` return ( ) } const AiUsage3 = (props: AiUsage3Props) => { const { errorThreshold = 0.01, models = [], status, title } = props const { description = describe(models, errorThreshold) } = props const state = getBlockState(status, models) const slowest = Math.max(0, ...models.map((model) => model.ttftP95)) return (
